Can I use any LLM to access the MCP Server? Xero's MCP Server will work with any MCP client that supports local/STDIO MCP servers. Depending on your MCP Client you might be able to support many different LLMs. All testing has been done using Claude Desktop and Cursor.

Will OAuth 2.0 support desktop/mobile/single-page apps that can’t keep a client secret confidential? Xero supports the Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE) extension to the authorization code flow. This allows native apps to securely connect to our API without needing to store a client secret. Single page apps are not currently supported.

What is the expiration for a refresh token? Unused refresh tokens expire after 60 days. If you don’t refresh your access token within 60 days the user will need to reauthorise your app. When you perform a token refresh, you should replace your existing refresh token with the new one returned in the response. If, for whatever reason, you don't receive the response you can retry refreshing your existing refresh token for a grace period of 30 minutes.

To allow a user to create API tokens and access the API:

1. Log in to your **Gladly instance**.
2. Open the **menu** on the top left-hand portion of the page.
3. Navigate to **Settings > Users**.
4. Search and click on the user profile that should have access.
5. You'll see a permission called **API User**. Select it, while keeping the user's Agent role intact.
6. Click **Save** to give access.
